I confirmed it to Pree in a thread reply in #central-team: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23.

I checked the knowledge brain first and found nothing already saved about Marrow Agrisupply. Its search is running in keyword-only mode, so that doesn't prove there's nothing there.

I didn't save the fact into the brain separately. Her message is already in the #central-team history the brain holds. A separate copy could show up for people outside that channel, and she said no action was needed.
